onboarding.yaml:
apiVersion: choregos/v1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: onboarding
  version: 1
  description: A joiner — access plan, account and groups ten days before, laptop seven days before, badge handed over, check the day after.
  inputs:
    type: object
    required: [nom, upn, date_arrivee, poste, groupe, groupe_sensible, adresse]
    properties:
      nom: { type: string, title: Full name }
      upn: { type: string, title: Sign-in name (UPN) }
      date_arrivee: { type: string, format: date, title: Start date }
      poste: { type: string, title: Job title }
      groupe: { type: string, title: Access group of the role }
      groupe_sensible: { type: string, title: Sensitive group (stronger approval) }
      adresse: { type: string, title: Laptop delivery address }
      modele: { type: string, title: Laptop model, default: portable-14 }
      badge_uid: { type: string, title: Badge UID }
initial: demande
actors:
  coordinateur: { type: agent, role: coordination, agent: coordinateur-onboarding, max_turns: 40, max_minutes: 20 }
  rh: { type: human, group: rh, sla_hours: 24 }
  accueil: { type: human, group: accueil, sla_hours: 8 }
  plateforme: { type: system }
states:
  demande: { display: Request received, kind: wait }
  plan: { display: Access plan proposed, kind: wait }
  valide: { display: Plan approved, kind: wait }
  comptes: { display: Account and group created, kind: wait }
  sensible: { display: Sensitive group decided, kind: wait }
  poste: { display: "Laptop ordered, enrolled, shipped", kind: wait }
  badge: { display: Badge handed over, kind: wait }
  actif: { display: Badge active, kind: wait }
  a_revoir: { display: To review, kind: wait }
  pret: { display: Joiner ready, terminal: true }
transitions:
  - id: t-plan
    from: demande
    to: plan
    by: coordinateur
    outputs: [plan_d_acces]
    gates: [outputs_present]
    on_fail: { to: demande, max_attempts: 2, escalate_to: a_revoir }

  - id: t-validation
    from: plan
    to: valide
    by: rh
    on_reject: a_revoir

  - id: t-comptes
    from: valide
    to: comptes
    by: plateforme
    action:
      kind: arrivee.comptes
      title: "Account and group of {{ fields.nom }}"
      justification: "starts on {{ fields.date_arrivee }} as {{ fields.poste }}"
      params: { upn: "{{ fields.upn }}", nom: "{{ fields.nom }}", groupe: "{{ fields.groupe }}" }
      effects:
        - effect: connector.call
          with:
            connector: annuaire
            operation: create_user
            arguments: { upn: "{{ params.upn }}", display_name: "{{ params.nom }}" }
          compensate:
            effect: connector.call
            with: { connector: annuaire, operation: disable_user, arguments: { upn: "{{ params.upn }}" } }
        - effect: connector.call
          with:
            connector: annuaire
            operation: add_to_group
            arguments: { upn: "{{ params.upn }}", group_id: "{{ params.groupe }}" }
          compensate:
            effect: connector.call
            with:
              connector: annuaire
              operation: remove_from_group
              arguments: { upn: "{{ params.upn }}", group_id: "{{ params.groupe }}" }
      not_before: fields.date_arrivee - 10d
    on_fail: { to: valide, max_attempts: 2, escalate_to: a_revoir }

  - id: t-sensible
    from: comptes
    to: sensible
    by: plateforme
    action:
      kind: arrivee.groupe_sensible
      title: "{{ fields.nom }} in {{ fields.groupe_sensible }}"
      params: { upn: "{{ fields.upn }}", groupe: "{{ fields.groupe_sensible }}" }
      effects:
        - effect: connector.call
          with:
            connector: annuaire
            operation: add_to_group
            arguments: { upn: "{{ params.upn }}", group_id: "{{ params.groupe }}" }
      approval:
        approvers: [{ role: project_owner, min: 1 }]
        step_up_minutes: 5
    on_fail: { to: comptes, max_attempts: 1, escalate_to: a_revoir }
    on_reject: sensible

  - id: t-poste
    from: sensible
    to: poste
    by: plateforme
    action:
      kind: arrivee.poste
      title: "Laptop of {{ fields.nom }} ({{ fields.modele | default('portable-14') }})"
      params:
        reference: "{{ work_item.key }}"
        upn: "{{ fields.upn }}"
        modele: "{{ fields.modele | default('portable-14') }}"
        adresse: "{{ fields.adresse }}"
      effects:
        - effect: connector.call
          with:
            connector: fournisseur
            operation: commander_poste
            arguments: { reference: "{{ params.reference }}", modele: "{{ params.modele }}", upn: "{{ params.upn }}" }
        - effect: connector.call
          with:
            connector: parc
            operation: enroll_device
            arguments: { serial: "{{ effects[0].serial }}", upn: "{{ params.upn }}" }
          compensate:
            effect: connector.call
            with: { connector: parc, operation: wipe_device, arguments: { serial: "{{ result.serial }}" } }
        - effect: connector.call
          with:
            connector: transporteur
            operation: create_shipment
            arguments:
              reference: "{{ params.reference }}-poste"
              address: "{{ params.adresse }}"
              items: ["{{ effects[0].serial }}"]
      not_before: fields.date_arrivee - 7d
    on_fail: { to: sensible, max_attempts: 2, escalate_to: a_revoir }

  - id: t-badge
    from: poste
    to: badge
    by: accueil
    task:
      title: Hand over the badge
      instructions: Hand the badge to its holder in person, then hold it to the reader to read its UID.
      form:
        type: object
        required: [badge_uid]
        properties:
          badge_uid: { type: string, title: Badge UID, minLength: 8 }
      attest: I handed the badge to its holder in person
    on_reject: a_revoir

  - id: t-activer
    from: badge
    to: actif
    by: plateforme
    action:
      kind: arrivee.badge
      title: "Activate badge {{ fields.badge_uid }}"
      params: { uid: "{{ fields.badge_uid }}", porteur: "{{ fields.upn }}" }
      effects:
        - effect: connector.call
          with:
            connector: lecteurs
            operation: activate_badge
            arguments: { uid: "{{ params.uid }}", holder: "{{ params.porteur }}" }
          compensate:
            effect: connector.call
            with: { connector: lecteurs, operation: deactivate_badge, arguments: { uid: "{{ params.uid }}" } }
    on_fail: { to: badge, max_attempts: 1, escalate_to: a_revoir }

  - id: t-controle
    from: actif
    to: pret
    by: plateforme
    action:
      kind: arrivee.controle
      title: "Check the onboarding of {{ fields.nom }}"
      params: { upn: "{{ fields.upn }}", uid: "{{ fields.badge_uid }}", reference: "{{ work_item.key }}-poste" }
      effects:
        - effect: connector.call
          with: { connector: annuaire, operation: get_user, arguments: { upn: "{{ params.upn }}" } }
        - effect: connector.call
          with: { connector: lecteurs, operation: badge_status, arguments: { uid: "{{ params.uid }}" } }
        - effect: connector.call
          with: { connector: transporteur, operation: shipment_status, arguments: { reference: "{{ params.reference }}" } }
        - effect: verifier
          with:
            condition: "{{ effects[0].user is not none and effects[1].active and effects[2].state != 'unknown' }}"
            motif: the account, the active badge and the laptop shipment
      not_before: fields.date_arrivee + 1d
    on_fail: { to: actif, max_attempts: 2, escalate_to: a_revoir }

metadata.name: onboarding
metadata.description: A joiner — access plan, account and groups ten days before, laptop seven days before, badge handed over, check the day after.

badge_task.title: Hand over the badge
badge_task.instructions: Hand the badge to its holder in person, then hold it to the reader to read its UID.
badge_task.attest: I handed the badge to its holder in person
